Spain vs France Delivered an EPIC EuroBasket Final!
Two European basketball giants faced off for the EuroBasket crown in the 2011 Final! Led by stars like Pau Gasol, Juan Carlos Navarro and Tony Parker, Spain and France brought elite talent to the biggest stage in European basketball. With the gold medal on the line, the stakes couldn't have been higher!
Relive the BEST moments from this unforgettable EuroBasket 2011 Final as Spain and France battled for European glory!
